title: Conditional κ = 0.001246073505487942: R740 replicated kernel with idle-data hosting
body:
## Result

Conditional **κ = 0.001246073505487942** (`623036752743971 / 500000000000000000`), **0.6886% above PR442**, with the bit supplier binding.

Compose PR443's R740 rank138 word and 32-replica layout with PR442's idle-data hosting interface. Hosting moves 159,168 helper residuals onto pending coordinates of untouched data pairs; all 53,952 remaining residuals fill complete banks. Live bit stock falls from 56,739 to 37,464, physical stock is 37,473, and the largest child falls from 42 to 8. Every local instruction, data owner, stage orientation, residual isometry and bridge remains identical to PR443.

The exact bit saving is `1247628141860215921989 / 10^24`. The complex supplier is freshly reconstructed from PR442 at `1267453159029119 / 10^18`; it is not merely cited.

## Verification

`research/r740-idle-hosted-replicas/verify.py` checks 234 byte-identical pinned upstream files, runs both parent verifiers, then independently audits the hosted construction and finite composition. The audit checks all 288 calls, 213,120 helper occurrences, last-touch windows, replica ownership, residual widths, disjoint slots, remainder children and stage-specific full banks. It recomputes the 5,681,952-instruction digest after ownership changes and rejects 14 corruptions.

Two rational moment engines agree; both finite invoices pass. The bit prefix uses 123 bits charged at 128, the two-level coefficient uses 286 bits charged at 512, and all helper routes retain the residual-isometry charge plus the hosting route charge. Six bootstrap levels, 47 strict inequalities, next-grid and parameter controls pass.

Validation: full Linux reconstruction; macOS quick mode (all new checks and full PR442 replay); repository-native `make verify-joint` including 16 tests. CI runs the full wrapper on Python 3.11 and 3.14.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-r740-replica32/parent436/requirements.txt
python -B research/r740-idle-hosted-replicas/verify.py /tmp/r740-hosted-new
```

## Scope and credit

This retains PR442's conditional idle-data hosting extension and all inherited all-size compiler, restored-work, common-grid, precision and analytic assumptions. The hosting operator lemma is the same mathematical review point as PR442. No unconditional multiplication theorem, κ = 1 result, or new Lean proof is claimed.

DaysSky's PR442 construction and assembly (Anthropic Claude assistance) and chafreaky's PR443 (OpenAI Codex assistance) are copied with complete notices/licenses and exact source pins. The new selection, integration, stronger independent audit and ownership digest were prepared by chafreaky with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Earlier contributions and disclosures remain in the unchanged upstream packages.
